title_sq: Ne Kombinat, Shitet Vile 2 Kateshe, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!!
description_sq: Ne Kombinat, shitet vile 2-kateshe me planimetri te rregullt. Trualli ne te cilen ndodhet prona ka nje siperfaqe prej 210 m2, nga ku 172 m2 eshte siperfaqe ndertimore. Secili kat i viles organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, tualeti, ne katin e pare eshte veranda ne shfrytezim, ndersa ne katin e dyte eshte ballkoni rrethues. Prona eshte e mireorganizuar, instalime elektrike, vetrata dopioxham, kati i pare totalisht i mobiluar, ndersa kati i dyte eshte i pamobiluar. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet vila ofron facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe larg zhurmave te Tiranes.
title_en: In Kombinat, 2-storey villa for sale, with a regular floor plan!!!
description_en: In Kombinat, a 2-story villa with a regular floor plan is for sale. The plot on which the property is located has a surface of 210 m2, of which 172 m2 is the building surface. Each floor of the villa is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen corner, 2 bedrooms, the toilet, on the first floor there is a veranda in use, while on the second floor there is a surrounding balcony. The property is well organized, electrical installations, double-glazed windows, the first floor is fully furnished, while the second floor is unfurnished. The area in which the villa is located offers the necessary facilities for a comfortable life away from the noise of Tirana.
